fixed: A shared file now imports when it has a custom field with the same key as one of yours but another name or other display settings, such as Caller's Companion's "Card" and "card". Your field is used as it is, with your name, choice order, Show in list, Searchable and Include in sharing settings. Before, the whole import failed with "Couldn't complete the import."

When a shared file's custom field has the same key as yours but another type or other choices, its values now go into the field with your key plus "_2", or the next free number (added the first time, and used again when the same file comes back), and import review says so before you import. Your own field is not changed. Before, the whole import failed.

changed: `ShareMetadataImporter` matches a custom field on its canonical key, type and, for a choice field, the set of choices. A field that differs goes to `<receiver key>_2`, `_3`, … (a compatible row already there is reused, two fields of one file never share a row, and every field tries its own key first, so a field that can keep its key is never moved to make room for one that clashes) and is noted as an `archive_custom_field_key_conflict` `ImportIssue` on the new `ShareMetadataImportResult.issues`, instead of throwing a `StateError`. Its `data` carries the receiver's own `label` and the new `key`, or nothing when the key is held by another field of the same file or by a deleted field.
`ShareMetadataImporter.preview` and `CompendiumArchiveImporter.planMetadataIssues` return those notes at plan time without writing.
